items.name: Spotify
items.author: CommandDeck

items.name: Stream Overlay
items.author: CommandDeck
items.description: Build broadcast scenes from text, images, GIFs, video, web pages, shapes, clocks and alerts, then switch between them live. Keep a name bar or webcam frame pinned across every scene, and put the whole thing on stream as an OBS browser source or a transparent window on top of your desktop.
